framework.reference: M.A. Rose, Quality Ranking System for Molten Salt Thermal Property Data, ANL/CFCT-22/26 (2022); applied as in M.A. Rose, Quality Ranking of Unary Fluoride Salt Property Data in MSTDB-TP, ANL/CFCT-23/48 (2023).
framework.adaptation: The six Rose aspects are kept; their criteria are re-worded for post-irradiation microstructural examination (EBSD, TEM, EPMA, SEM). 'Composition analysis' becomes 'sample characterization', 'environmental controls' becomes 'irradiation-condition knowledge'. Verifiability is assessed per value from its provenance (see verifiability_by_provenance below).
principles_from_rose: Assess each data set on the source publication only; agreement with other data sets does NOT raise the rank (the same error can be repeated by several groups).
Keep all data, including superseded or low-rank entries.
Keep the history of assessments (assessor, date, notes) with each data set.
Mark the state-of-the-art value of each quantity: highest overall rank, then lowest uncertainty.
Re-assess when methods become standardized or biases are found.

method.H: Standardized method with international consensus followed (e.g. ISO 13067 / ASTM E2627 EBSD grain size) and cited
method.M: Well-established technique used at several laboratories (EBSD misorientation analysis, TEM g.b and line-length counting, EPMA mapping, SEM image analysis); indicators and thresholds defined in the paper
method.I: Procedure unique to one laboratory or not described enough to be reproduced

calibration.H: Response to a reference material verified AND all instruments calibrated (pattern-centre/step calibration, thickness standard, EPMA standards) and reported
calibration.M: Reference material response verified (e.g. unirradiated or single-crystal reference measured with the same procedure) OR instrument calibrations reported
calibration.I: No calibration or reference measurement reported

sample_characterization.H: Fabrication data (enrichment, grain size, density/porosity, dopant) AND measured local burnup (e.g. EPMA-Nd profile) or equivalent measured local state
sample_characterization.M: Fabrication data partly given and specimen-average burnup reported
sample_characterization.I: Specimen burnup or fabrication data not reported

irradiation_conditions.H: Local temperature measured (thermocouples) or controlled by design (e.g. isothermal disc irradiation with verified temperatures)
irradiation_conditions.M: Power and temperature history at the specimen position calculated with a fuel-performance code or correlation and published
irradiation_conditions.I: Irradiation conditions not reported beyond rod-average values

measurement_precision.H: Uncertainty quantified from at least three replicate measurements (fields, grains, lamellae)
measurement_precision.M: Propagated uncertainty or uncertainty budget (e.g. counting statistics + thickness), or standard error reported

verifiability.H: Raw data provided (EBSD maps .ang/.ctf/.h5, TEM images at full resolution, EPMA line data) and the reported value can be recomputed
verifiability.M: Reported values tabulated or stated in the text, with the definition/processing of the indicator
verifiability.I: Value only available in a figure (digitized) or quoted second-hand

overall_rank.A: H or M for all quality criteria and verifiability H
overall_rank.B: H or M for two or more quality criteria and verifiability H or M
overall_rank.C: Values calculated with models in the absence of measured values
overall_rank.U*: Uncertainties do not warrant quantitative use; all aspects but verifiability are H or M
overall_rank.U: Uncertainties do not warrant quantitative use

local_conditions_model.summary: Local temperature and burnup at every radial point. Temperature: Halden-conductivity model for ZAC2022 and GER2018, reported for ONO2025 (Alcyone) and NOI2015 (FTEMP). Burnup: rim-profile model for ZAC2022 and ONO2025; literature values from Barani et al. 2020 for GER2018 and the NOI2015 76 GWd/tHM disc. Model values are Rose rank C.

temperature.equation: (1/r) d/dr( r k(T,bu) dT/dr ) = -q'''(r);  k dT/dr = -q_in(r)/(2 pi r), q_in = linear power generated inside r
temperature.conductivity: Halden (Wiesenack, HWR-469): k = 1/(0.1148 + 0.0035 b + 2.475e-4 (1 - 0.00333 b) T) + 0.0132 exp(0.00188 T); k in W/m/K, T in C, b = local burnup in MWd/kgUO2 = 0.8815 x MWd/kgU. Gerczak 2018 Eq. (1) uses the same form without the last (electronic) term; its printed '8e-4 b' coefficient is a typo for 2.475e-4 x 0.00333 = 8.24e-7.
temperature.power_shape: q'''(r) proportional to the local burnup shape f(r) below (rim power peaking)
temperature.boundary_condition: centreline temperature from the paper (Alcyone for ZAC2022, Halden correlation for GER2018); marched outwards (RK2, 400 cells)
temperature.history: ZAC2022: Fig. 1b centreline temperature and Fig. 1a linear power histories, burnup(t) proportional to the cumulative linear power, local T(r,t) averaged over operating periods (T_c > 300 C and LHR > 60 W/cm). GER2018: Fig. 1 centre temperature and LHR vs burnup, local T averaged over burnup. Rim amplitude grows linearly with burnup during the history.

burnup_profile.form: bu(r)/bu_avg = f(r) = c [1 + p1 exp(-p2 d^p3)], d = depth below the pellet surface in mm, c normalises the area average to 1 (Lassmann/TUBRNP-type rim profile)
burnup_profile.p2_p3_fitted_on: EPMA-Nd shapes of ONO2025 Std-37 (Fig. 3) and ZAC2022 Std-61 (Fig. 2, produced Xe from Nd); Lassmann default p2 = 3, p3 = 0.45 fits them with rms 0.04-0.05 instead of 0.02-0.03
burnup_profile.amplitude: p1 set so that f(R) = measured edge/average burnup ratio: EPMA-Nd 1R burnup / specimen burnup where the paper gives it; otherwise the linear fit of those six ratios vs burnup; NOI2015 discs: edge 19 % above centre (text)
burnup_profile.uncertainty: shape rms 0.02-0.03 on the fitted profiles; noisy for one-cycle fuel (Std-16, rms 0.09); GER2018 (2.9 % enrichment, 9.06 mm pellet) uses the fit without measured edge value
